why: Evenly spaced arrivals fall where the offered rate, added up since the last, reaches one more request (engine 1.6.1); the frozen engine 0.16.0 took the gap to the next from the rate at the last arrival, so on a trace whose rate changes it sent other requests at other times. These runs' arrivals follow such a trace, so every part of their reports that their requests make moves with them: those parts, listed for each run, are the Java's own and pinned by their digest, and the rest of each report is compared with the frozen engine's.
